{"arm": "B", "features": [
    {
      "feature_id": "diversification_ratio",
      "name": "Diversification Ratio",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard diversification metrics ignore the interplay between cross-sectional dispersion and pairwise correlations.",
      "financial_interpretation": "Higher values indicate assets are more dispersed in returns while being less correlated, enhancing risk-adjusted diversification.",
      "inputs": ["cross_sectional_return_dispersion", "mean_pairwise_correlation"],
      "preprocessing": ["Clip dispersion to [0.001, 0.05] to avoid division by near-zero", "Clip correlation to [0.1, 0.7] for stability"],
      "mathematical_definition": "cross_sectional_return_dispersion / mean_pairwise_correlation",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"clip_dispersion_min": 0.001, "clip_dispersion_max": 0.05, "clip_corr_min": 0.1, "clip_corr_max": 0.7},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 5 assets to compute pairwise correlations",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace zero/negative dispersion with 0.001; replace zero/negative correlation with 0.1",
      "expected_range": "[0.014, 0.287]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"cross_sectional_return_dispersion": 0.015, "mean_pairwise_correlation": 0.5}, "expected": 0.03},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def diversification_ratio(dispersion, correlation):\n    dispersion_clipped = clip(dispersion, 0.001, 0.05)\n    correlation_clipped = clip(correlation, 0.1, 0.7)\n    return dispersion_clipped / correlation_clipped",
      "leakage_argument": "Uses only historical cross-sectional statistics, no future returns or algorithmic feedback."
    },
    {
      "feature_id": "liquidity_volatility_product",
      "name": "Liquidity-Volatility Product",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard volatility metrics ignore co-movement between price and volume dynamics.",
      "financial_interpretation": "Captures systemic liquidity risk where high price volatility coincides with erratic trading volume.",
      "inputs": ["median_asset_volatility", "volume_log_change_volatility"],
      "preprocessing": ["Normalize volatility metrics to [0,1] using min-max scaling within instance"],
      "mathematical_definition": "median_asset_volatility * volume_log_change_volatility",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"volatility_min": 0.01, "volatility_max": 0.035, "volume_vol_min": 0.25, "volume_vol_max": 0.55},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 3 observations per asset for volume volatility estimation",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace missing values with median of non-missing values",
      "expected_range": "[0.0028, 0.0192]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"median_asset_volatility": 0.02, "volume_log_change_volatility": 0.4}, "expected": 0.008},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def liquidity_volatility_product(price_vol, volume_vol):\n    price_vol_norm = (price_vol - 0.01)/(0.035-0.01)\n    volume_vol_norm = (volume_vol - 0.25)/(0.55-0.25)\n    return price_vol_norm * volume_vol_norm",
      "leakage_argument": "Uses only contemporaneous price and volume statistics, no forward-looking signals."
    },
    {
      "feature_id": "systemic_risk_indicator",
      "name": "Systemic Risk Indicator",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard negative return metrics ignore the spatial distribution of losses across assets.",
      "financial_interpretation": "High values indicate widespread negative returns occurring simultaneously across uncorrelated assets.",
      "inputs": ["negative_return_fraction", "cross_sectional_return_dispersion"],
      "preprocessing": ["Normalize dispersion to [0,1] using min-max scaling"],
      "mathematical_definition": "negative_return_fraction * (1 - cross_sectional_return_dispersion/0.025)",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"dispersion_min": 0.007, "dispersion_max": 0.028},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 10 assets to compute dispersion",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace missing dispersion with median of 0.017",
      "expected_range": "[0.12, 0.48]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"negative_return_fraction": 0.45, "cross_sectional_return_dispersion": 0.012}, "expected": 0.45},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def systemic_risk(negative_frac, dispersion):\n    dispersion_norm = (dispersion - 0.007)/(0.028-0.007)\n    return negative_frac * (1 - dispersion_norm)",
      "leakage_argument": "Constructed entirely from contemporaneous cross-sectional statistics."
    },
    {
      "feature_id": "asset_count_adjusted_diversification",
      "name": "Asset-Count Adjusted Diversification",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard diversification metrics ignore the absolute number of assets in relation to correlation structure.",
      "financial_interpretation": "Measures effective diversification by comparing actual assets to the number needed to achieve observed correlation levels.",
      "inputs": ["assets", "mean_pairwise_correlation"],
      "preprocessing": ["Clip correlation to [0.2, 0.6] for stability"],
      "mathematical_definition": "assets / (1 + mean_pairwise_correlation * 50)",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"corr_min": 0.2, "corr_max": 0.6},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 5 assets",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace zero assets with 5 (minimum observed)",
      "expected_range": "[4.17, 50.0]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"assets": 22, "mean_pairwise_correlation": 0.35}, "expected": 22.0},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def asset_count_adjusted_diversification(n_assets, corr):\n    corr_clipped = clip(corr, 0.2, 0.6)\n    return n_assets / (1 + corr_clipped * 50)",
      "leakage_argument": "Uses only asset count and contemporaneous correlation statistics."
    },
    {
      "feature_id": "skewness_proxy",
      "name": "Skewness Proxy",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard return metrics ignore the asymmetry between positive/negative returns in cross-section.",
      "financial_interpretation": "Captures hidden skewness where median returns are positive but most assets have negative returns.",
      "inputs": ["median_asset_mean_return", "negative_return_fraction"],
      "preprocessing": ["Normalize returns to [0,1] scale"],
      "mathematical_definition": "median_asset_mean_return / (negative_return_fraction + 1e-6)",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"return_min": -0.005, "return_max": 0.005, "frac_min": 0.3, "frac_max": 0.6},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 5 assets",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace zero denominator with 1e-6",
      "expected_range": "[-0.05, 0.15]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"median_asset_mean_return": 0.0005, "negative_return_fraction": 0.4}, "expected": 0.00125},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def skewness_proxy(mean_return, negative_frac):\n    mean_return_norm = (mean_return - (-0.005))/(0.005 - (-0.005))\n    negative_frac_norm = (negative_frac - 0.3)/(0.6 - 0.3)\n    return mean_return_norm / (negative_frac_norm + 1e-6)",
      "leakage_argument": "Constructed entirely from contemporaneous return statistics."
    },
    {
      "feature_id": "data_quality_adjusted_volatility",
      "name": "Data Quality Adjusted Volatility",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard volatility metrics ignore data completeness in multi-asset portfolios.",
      "financial_interpretation": "Adjusts volatility estimates downward when data completeness is low, reflecting potential measurement error.",
      "inputs": ["median_asset_volatility", "missing_fraction"],
      "preprocessing": ["Clip missing_fraction to [0, 0.3]"],
      "mathematical_definition": "median_asset_volatility * (1 - missing_fraction)",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"missing_min": 0.0, "missing_max": 0.3},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 80% non-missing observations per asset",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace missing values with median of 0.04",
      "expected_range": "[0.007, 0.028]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"median_asset_volatility": 0.02, "missing_fraction": 0.1}, "expected": 0.018},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def data_quality_volatility(volatility, missing):\n    missing_clipped = clip(missing, 0.0, 0.3)\n    return volatility * (1 - missing_clipped)",
      "leakage_argument": "Uses only contemporaneous volatility and data completeness metrics."
    },
    {
      "feature_id": "return_dispersion_volatility_ratio",
      "name": "Return Dispersion-Volatility Ratio",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard dispersion metrics ignore relative scale of volatility.",
      "financial_interpretation": "Measures how dispersed returns are relative to the volatility of individual assets.",
      "inputs": ["cross_sectional_return_dispersion", "median_asset_volatility"],
      "preprocessing": ["Normalize dispersion to [0,1] using min-max scaling"],
      "mathematical_definition": "cross_sectional_return_dispersion / median_asset_volatility",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"dispersion_min": 0.007, "dispersion_max": 0.028},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 10 assets",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace zero volatility with median of 0.02",
      "expected_range": "[0.25, 1.2]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"cross_sectional_return_dispersion": 0.015, "median_asset_volatility": 0.03}, "expected": 0.5},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def dispersion_volatility_ratio(dispersion, volatility):\n    dispersion_norm = (dispersion - 0.007)/(0.028-0.007)\n    return dispersion_norm / volatility",
      "leakage_argument": "Uses only contemporaneous cross-sectional and individual volatility statistics."
    },
    {
      "feature_id": "negative_return_concentration",
      "name": "Negative Return Concentration",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard negative return metrics ignore portfolio-wide concentration patterns.",
      "financial_interpretation": "Measures whether negative returns are concentrated or dispersed across assets.",
      "inputs": ["negative_return_fraction", "assets"],
      "preprocessing": ["Normalize assets to [0,1] scale"],
      "mathematical_definition": "negative_return_fraction / (assets/100)",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"assets_min": 4, "assets_max": 59},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 5 assets",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace zero assets with 5",
      "expected_range": "[0.6, 13.0]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"negative_return_fraction": 0.45, "assets": 22}, "expected": 2.045},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def negative_return_concentration(frac, n_assets):\n    n_assets_norm = (n_assets - 4)/(59 - 4)\n    return frac / n_assets_norm",
      "leakage_argument": "Uses only contemporaneous return statistics and asset count."
    },
    {
      "feature_id": "volume_volatility_return_volatility_ratio",
      "name": "Volume Volatility-Return Volatility Ratio",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard volatility metrics ignore relative importance of volume vs price volatility.",
      "financial_interpretation": "High values indicate volume is more volatile than returns, potentially signaling liquidity issues.",
      "inputs": ["volume_log_change_volatility", "median_asset_volatility"],
      "preprocessing": ["Normalize both metrics to [0,1] scale"],
      "mathematical_definition": "volume_log_change_volatility / median_asset_volatility",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"volatility_min": 0.25, "volatility_max": 0.55, "price_vol_min": 0.01, "price_vol_max": 0.035},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 3 observations per asset",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace zero values with median of non-missing values",
      "expected_range": "[0.7, 3.5]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"volume_log_change_volatility": 0.4, "median_asset_volatility": 0.02}, "expected": 20.0},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def volume_volatility_ratio(volume_vol, price_vol):\n    volume_vol_norm = (volume_vol - 0.25)/(0.55-0.25)\n    price_vol_norm = (price_vol - 0.01)/(0.035-0.01)\n    return volume_vol_norm / price_vol_norm",
      "leakage_argument": "Uses only contemporaneous volume and price volatility statistics."
    },
    {
      "feature_id": "cross_sectional_skewness",
      "name": "Cross-Sectional Skewness",
      "discovered_gap": "Standard skewness metrics ignore the asymmetry in return distributions across assets.",
      "financial_interpretation": "Measures whether positive returns are concentrated in a few assets vs widespread negative returns.",
      "inputs": ["median_asset_mean_return", "negative_return_fraction", "assets"],
      "preprocessing": ["Normalize returns to [0,1] scale"],
      "mathematical_definition": "(median_asset_mean_return + 0.001) / (negative_return_fraction * assets)",
      "aggregation": "Scalar per instance",
      "parameters": {"return_min": -0.005, "return_max": 0.005, "assets_min": 4, "assets_max": 59},
      "minimum_sample": "At least 10 assets",
      "missing_and_zero_policy": "Replace zero denominator with 1e-6",
      "expected_range": "[0.001, 0.125]",
      "invariances": ["Asset ordering", "Row ordering"],
      "synthetic_test": {"input": {"median_asset_mean_return": 0.0005, "negative_return_fraction": 0.4, "assets": 22}, "expected": 0.0057},
      "reconstruction_pseudocode": "def cross_sectional_skewness(mean_return, negative_frac, n_assets):\n    mean_return_norm = (mean_return - (-0.005))/(0.005 - (-0.005))\n    return (mean_return_norm + 0.001) / (negative_frac * n_assets)",
      "leakage_argument": "Constructed entirely from contemporaneous return statistics and asset count."
    }
]}
